field.name: as_us_national
field.comment: True if taxpayer is US national (not US citizen) from American Samoa

field.name: as_us_citizen
field.comment: True if taxpayer is US citizen

field.name: as_bona_fide_resident
field.comment: True if taxpayer meets bona fide resident test for American Samoa

field.name: as_days_present
field.comment: Number of days present in American Samoa during tax year

field.name: as_has_tax_home
field.comment: True if taxpayer has tax home in American Samoa

field.name: as_closer_connection
field.comment: True if taxpayer has closer connection to AS than US

field.name: as_self_employment_income
field.comment: Self-employment income (subject to US SE tax if >= $400)

field.name: as_requires_us_se_tax
field.comment: True if subject to US self-employment tax (>= $400)

field.name: as_only_as_income
field.comment: True if taxpayer has only AS-source income

field.name: as_files_with_asg
field.comment: True if taxpayer files with American Samoa Government

field.name: as_files_with_irs
field.comment: True if taxpayer also files with IRS (for SE tax or US income)

field.name: as_uses_frozen_irc_2000
field.comment: American Samoa uses IRC as of year 2000 (frozen)

field.name: as_income_tax
field.comment: Calculated American Samoa income tax liability
